title: The tavern's bottles
logline: The tavern's back step in November with the night's bottles in a crate, the beer sign's puddle, and the pup's nose at the crate. Twenty years of the same crate on the same step, drawn once.

panels.composition: A tavern's back step in November with a crate of empty bottles on it and a small three-legged dog's nose at the crate, a beer sign's neon in a puddle.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a tavern's back step in November with a crate of empty bottles on it and a small three-legged dog sniffing the crate, a neon beer sign reflected in a puddle, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
